question: Find the value of (sin A-2sin³A)/(2cos³A-cos A)+sqrt{cosec²A-1}
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use the value putting method by assuming A = 30° (avoid 45° as it makes the denominator zero).

Expression = (sin 30° − 2sin³30°) ÷ (2cos³30° − cos 30°) + √(cosec²30° − 1)

⇒ (1/2 − 2×(1/8)) ÷ (2×(3√3/8) − √3/2) + √(4 − 1)

⇒ (1/4) ÷ (√3/4) + √3 = 1/√3 + √3 = 4/√3

Checking Option 1: sec 30° × cosec 30° = (2/√3) × 2 = 4/√3 (Matches perfectly).

**∴ The correct answer is sec A cosec A.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

(sin A − 2sin³A) / (2cos³A − cos A) + √(cosec²A − 1)

**Formula Used:**

cos 2A = 1 − 2sin²A = 2cos²A − 1

cosec²A − 1 = cot²A

**Calculation:**

⇒ [sin A × (1 − 2sin²A)] / [cos A × (2cos²A − 1)] + √(cot²A)

⇒ [sin A × cos 2A] / [cos A × cos 2A] + cot A

⇒ (sin A / cos A) + cot A

⇒ tan A + cot A

⇒ (sin A / cos A) + (cos A / sin A)

⇒ (sin²A + cos²A) / (sin A × cos A)

⇒ 1 / (sin A × cos A)

⇒ (1 / cos A) × (1 / sin A)

⇒ sec A × cosec A

**∴ The correct answer is sec A cosec A.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pythagorean Identities

sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ, and 1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ.

Double Angle Formulas

cos 2θ = cos²θ − sin²θ = 2cos²θ − 1 = 1 − 2sin²θ.

Reciprocal Identities

tan θ = sin θ / cos θ and cot θ = cos θ / sin θ. Also, sec θ = 1 / cos θ and cosec θ = 1 / sin θ.
